coverage_notes: Visually inspected all supplied anchors (PDF pp.3-4), composition Table I (p.1), and method/reference/temperature text (p.2). Poppler missing-font warnings did not prevent reading the viewed evidence.
shared_qualifications: Table I (PDF p.1) contains NA composition cells for intermediate heats; the footnote says not analyzed but within the series. CRA 389,390,393-395 omit Cr/Ni and calculate a near-pure-Fe balance inconsistent with the stainless-steel series. Their identity is supported by the exact Mo heat, Table III series order and acid condition, not by the erroneous Fe balance.

C2: scan rates in mV/hr divided by 3600 give mV/s: 2000 -> 0.555556; 600 -> 0.166667; 60 -> 0.0166667; 20 -> 0.00555556. CRA 403 lists 0.0167 although its independently identified 655 mV Table IV result uses 20 mV/hr. Preserve this source/CSV method conflict.
Table III NP means no pitting up to 0.8 V vs SCE. CSV >800 is retained as a qualitative/bound target, not a measured threshold or exact strict-inequality agreement.

CRA 402 is a 495-525 mV summary of the two standard 600-then-60 mV/hr Table IV runs. obs_018/019 are its individual endpoints, not two copies of an aggregate. Fig.7 obs_034/035 are possible repeated presentations but remain candidate-only because individual run identity is unstated.
